brief: 075 civic restyle (Vela, 2026-10-29). Sky: "could we bring the civic block into looking more aligned without ruining the game logic?" Visual only: the testbed's Records Office, café and square kept as built, dressed in the old town's materials. Table and reasons: briefs/075/civic/restyle.md.
frame: plan metres (Unity x, z = plan x, y); yaw = the export's kit yaw (KitPlacer: Unity euler y = -yaw in degrees); z = height of the piece's pivot
locked: No mesh, footprint, height, door, mission point, bay, cover, collider, walkable surface or furniture position changes. No FBX is regenerated, so contracts/world/kit.collide.json, the world export and sim/data are untouched. Every change below is a material slot on a renderer the builder already makes, a ground material, or a scene-only overlay with no collider.
scope: the renderers under the scene's `civic` group (world.civic: civic/cafe*, civic/civic-office*, civic/office-*-entrance, civic/run-*, civic/band/*, civic/*), never a piece of the same id elsewhere in the district

remap.why: the old stone anchors (Hall, DecoBay, CornerTower) are DK_Limestone_Tex: the old facade_panel_v1 sheet, 2 m panels with joints, white tint. The meshes' UVs are world metres (probe: 0.97-1.00 UV per m2), so the sheet lands at the old 2 m panel

the charcoal spandrels between the windows (1080 m2) become the old ribbon window: one continuous dark teal glass band per storey (DK_GlassDark #35585A, the old glass). Doors keep charcoal: the entrance pieces are not in this rule

the café is a streamline building: the old town paints those in smooth render (DK_Render_White), here the old Circus ensemble's Naples cream #EBDCB5 (old DecoKitColourways.Circus). It differs from the office's panel stone, so the two neighbours never match
the upper storeys' sill bands take the Circus sills, the old coral #C8553D ribbon: the old town's pinstripe colour on cream
the shopfront fascia takes the Circus fascia, the old deep teal #1F6C67 (the old shop-fascia slot)
planter walls and the terrace edge in the old panel stone, like the office

variants.note: a studied alternative, not the proposal: the café as a stone building (old panel stone in the Circus cream), its seafoam bands kept. Renders: *-alt-*.png

ground.why: the old plaza field (DecoKitPlazaLayout.Floor: an ivory terrazzo field with seafoam rings, the hall's plaza): our square already has the rings, so it takes the old floor under them. Pale and polished, as the Records Office painting's forecourt

the office forecourt on the same civic floor, so square and office read as one precinct. Tried in the old pavement flags (OldTownArt DK_Pave_Flags at 4 m, render 1): at play zoom the small cool-grey flags were busy against the office and broke the precinct in two

overlays.mount: the café front's outer piers (probe: pier faces at x -164.75 and -153.35, y -219.7), under the canopy: basket 2.57-3.34 m above the walk, 0.79 m out. The two door piers stay bare (Inez's door)
the café front's outer piers (probe: pier faces at x -164.75 and -153.35, y -219.7), under the canopy: basket 2.57-3.34 m above the walk, 0.79 m out. The two door piers stay bare (Inez's door)

overlayRules: Old DecoKitDistrictDressing.Terrace: baskets on the piers under the canopy (HangingBasket every pier run), one BladeSign_Cafe per café above the canopy. The café already carries its own blade sign (CafeUpper_3's CAFE fin over the door), so the old rule is met and no second sign is added (tried on the side walls: the upper's side walls only start at 10 m, probe in after-probe.json, and two more CAFE fins read as clutter). Only wall pieces above 2.4 m: nothing stands on the walk, so no cover, bay, sightline or walk changes. Scene-only (not in the world export, so not in sim/data); colliders stripped; parented under civic/cafe so they take its fade. Left out on purpose: TerraceScreen, PottedFern and SandwichBoard (they stand on the terrace and the walk), rooftop billboards (they sit between the camera and the terrace at yaw 210, and the office is civic).

kept.why: tried as the old plaza's seafoam terrazzo (DK_Terrazzo_Seafoam): on the ivory terrazzo field the rings and the spine lost their contrast at play zoom (render 1, out/scratch/vela/civic075). They mark the café door line and the square's walk, so readable > rich: the enamel stays

ground_note: tile 1 = UV in world metres, as look.json's other ground keys; the terrazzo .mat repeats every 1.5 m itself (m_Scale 0.667), exactly the old kit tile. Only these two plots: the pavements beyond the kerbs stay as they are

surfaces.why: the bed kerbs in the same panel stone as the planter runs and the office
